{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_dup_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {patient_dup_count}')

# Check which patient_ids are duplicated and how many times
dup_patients = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
dup_patients = dup_patients[dup_patients > 1]
print(f'Duplicated patient_ids and their counts:\n{dup_patients}')

# Check sample_seq for each duplicated patient to see if there's a higher one
retest_rows = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)].sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'])
print(f'Rows for duplicated patients (sorted by sample_seq):\n{retest_rows[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']]}')"}
